name: Incremental Contouring via Power Diagrams
definition: Extracts an isosurface from a signed distance function by constructing a weighted triangulation (regular/power diagram or standard Delaunay) of grid samples, then incrementally refining the sample set based on geometric criteria before extracting the mesh.
summary: Incremental Contouring via Power Diagrams is a progressive isosurface extraction algorithm that builds meshes from Signed Distance Fields by iteratively refining weighted triangulations to ensure topological correctness without global recomputation.
